quote:
Honestly it is pretty difficult to see or feel any difference on any of these. Please do a simple set of squares, a calibration, something like most people do when picking ironing settings.

There's also no need for that "every item has a control" thing, I think you misunderstood what I was asking for when you added that.
requested_next_calibration: Simple flat squares with varied ironing settings; no duplicate un-ironed specimen for every condition.
scope: Operator assessment of the completed feature-crop comparison. The report does not establish equal roughness, a preferred recipe, or water-holding performance.
